uncertainReason: sheetSpeedTicks: the infobox says 'attack speed = Varies' (rendered 'Variable'). The volley stages run '3 tick attacks' -> '2 tick' -> '2 tick' -> '1 tick' -> '1 tick' -> two 'faster projectile time' stages, and the enrage is fixed at 2 ticks; 2 is the modal per-orb cadence, not a wiki value. Cycle = one orb/attack action.
cycleArithmetic: The wiki never says how many orbs make a volley, nor whether a special follows every roar; both are assumed. Assumed kill = 5 volleys of 10 orbs (stages 1-5, no stun reset) = 50 orbs to reach the 180-HP enrage + 6 roars (one per volley + 'the boss roars, one debris set drops' at enrage start) + 5 specials (alternating Lightning Barrage / Smoke Blast) + 15 enrage orbs (180 HP at 2-tick orbs) = 76 cycles. Orb styles: stages 1, 2, 4 are 'magic and ranged' = 30 orbs (15 magic, 15 ranged); stages 3, 5 are 'all three styles' = 20 orbs (6.67 each). Shares sum to 0.999.

phases: Volleys progress through seven stages ('Leviathan will progress down this list, of attack styles, throughout the fight whether you stun or not!'): 3-tick M/R, 2-tick M/R, 2-tick all three, 1-tick M/R, 1-tick all three, all three '2 ticks to react', all three '1 tick to react'. Each volley ends with a roar (7 chip) + debris, then a special (Lightning Barrage / Smoke Blast alternate; the first is told by the first roar's debris: east-west = Lightning Barrage, north-south = Smoke Blast). Stun: 'players can cast any type of shadow spell to stun the Leviathan where it will stay still for 15 ticks (9 seconds)'; 'Damage against it is capped at 10 when stunned'; hitting the back wound or dealing 25% of its health during the stun makes it 'reset to the 2nd attack style on the list and then progress downwards again' (next reset to the 3rd, and so on), and 'The Leviathan will break out of its stun when this occurs and use a special attack as retaliation.' Enrage at 180 HP (20%): fixed 2-tick cadence, magic + ranged orbs only, bite still possible, abyssal pathfinder (5x5) moving clockwise - outside it 'its attacks will pierce through prayer' and your damage drops; inside: perfect accuracy + raised minimum hit (magic: double damage); debris keeps falling until it dies.
sanityOrOther: No sanity. Specials cut your damage: 'Damage dealt to the Leviathan is reduced by 33% for the duration of each special attack.' Debris permanently blocks tiles ('a permanent spawn for the remainder of the fight'; all removed on death). Pathfinder rule in the enrage (see phases). Poisonable (category 'Monsters susceptible to poison'). Perfect kill excludes 'rapid-fire volleys, debris, bites, Lightning Barrage, Smoke Blast' damage.
